ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-1: Zero-price bypass in validateHandlerOrder — computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow, validateHandlerOrder does not check for sqrtPriceX96==0, potentially bypassing max pricing bounds
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: When computeRatioX96 returns 0, the minSqrtPriceX96 check will revert for any non-zero min bound. Only exploitable when min bound is 0 (no lower bound set), which means the creator chose not to enforce a price floor. Even then, overflow requires extreme uint256 amounts. Known pattern CP-003, classified Low.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-2: Direct handler call — calling CLOBTransferHandler.executeSwap directly bypasses AMM hook pricing enforcement in beforeSwap/afterSwap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOBTransferHandler has no executeSwap function. The handler entry point ammHandleTransfer is only callable by AMM. Direct CLOB operations (openOrder) do call _enforceTokenHooks for hook validation. No bypass path exists.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-3: Settings sync gap — setTokenSettings may leave stale memSettings in CreatorHookSettingsRegistry, causing initialized field desync
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Registry calls registryUpdateTokenSettings on AMMStandardHook which directly overwrites _tokenSettings[token]. No window for desync during swap operations. _getOrFetchTokenSettings always returns current state. Known pattern CP-005 (gas waste only).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: KV-4: Transient storage leak — DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT written in beforeSwap but not cleared, leaving stale data for next swap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Each direct swap's beforeSwap call overwrites the slot at line 839. The afterSwap reads the value written by the SAME swap's beforeSwap. For pool swaps (poolType != address(0)), the slot is never accessed. Cross-path contamination is impossible. Known pattern CP-001.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Reentrancy via _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers — flags cleared during hook fee distribution allows re-entry
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) at line 3190 preserves the ENTERED bit (TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags.sol:69-71). Only custom flags are cleared. Core reentrancy guard remains active. Test confirms re-entry reverts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: ETH refund reentrancy — _depositWrappedNativeAndRefundExcess sends ETH to executor, callback re-enters AMM
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Reentrancy guard (ENTERED bit) is set before any external calls in the swap/liquidity flow. ETH refund callback cannot re-enter any protected function. Test confirms revert on re-entry attempt.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan profit via swap round-trip — borrow tokens, swap A->B, swap B->A, profit from price impact
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Pool fees (30 BPS) are always consumed. Fuzz testing with 25 random loan amounts confirms attacker always loses money. Round-trip never profitable.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Cross-pool arbitrage value leak — large swap in pool A shifts price, arbitrage pool B leaks value
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Each pool is independently solvent. Cross-pool arbitrage through the AMM's own interface always costs fees. Test confirms no value leak.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Dust loop extraction — 100+ tiny swaps accumulate rounding errors in attacker's favor
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Rounding always favors protocol (mulDivRoundingUp against user). 100-iteration dust loop test confirms pool does not leak value. Attacker loses more to fees than gains from rounding.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Multi-swap state isolation — intermediate state observable by hooks between swaps in multiSwap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Each pool swap in multiSwap is fully finalized before the next begins. Hooks see consistent state. Test with 2-pool multi-swap confirms both pools remain solvent.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Add liquidity + swap same-TX — phantom liquidity or stale tick state at boundary
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Liquidity operations and swaps use separate reentrancy guard flags. State is fully committed after addLiquidity before swap begins. Test confirms no phantom liquidity.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Settings change + immediate swap — swap reads stale cached settings after registry update
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: registryUpdateTokenSettings directly overwrites _tokenSettings[token] in AMMStandardHook. _getOrFetchTokenSettings returns current state. No window for stale reads during swap.

theft_theses.thesis: Reentrancy via _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers clears custom flags — could allow re-entry during hook fee ERC20 transfers
Transient storage stale read in DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT corrupts pricing bounds check for second direct swap
Flash loan + swap round trip extracts value from pool via price impact
